description: This file defines the Chromium class extending BrowserType, implementing methods for launching, connecting, and managing Chromium browser instances within the Playwright project. It includes logic for handling CDP connections, Selenium hub integration, and startup log rewriting.

classes.name: Chromium
classes.description: Represents the Chromium browser type within Playwright, providing methods for launching, connecting, and managing Chromium instances, including support for CDP and Selenium.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Launches a Chromium browser instance with specified options, possibly via a bidi (BiDi) channel.

methods.name: launchPersistentContext
methods.description: Creates a persistent browser context with user data directory and options.

methods.name: connectOverCDP
methods.description: Connects to an existing Chromium instance over the Chrome DevTools Protocol.

methods.name: _connectOverCDPImpl
methods.description: Internal implementation for establishing a CDP connection, managing cleanup and browser process.

methods.name: connectOverCDPTransport
methods.description: Connects to a Chromium instance over an existing transport.

methods.name: _createDevTools
methods.description: Creates a CRDevTools instance for debugging.

methods.name: connectToTransport
methods.description: Establishes a CRBrowser connection over a transport, with error handling for profile conflicts.

methods.name: doRewriteStartupLog
methods.description: Rewrites startup logs to provide clearer error messages related to sandboxing and X server issues.

methods.name: amendEnvironment
methods.description: Modifies environment variables for the browser process.

methods.name: attemptToGracefullyCloseBrowser
methods.description: Sends a command to close the browser gracefully via transport.

methods.name: _launchWithSeleniumHub
methods.description: Launches a Chromium instance via a Selenium hub, handling capabilities and WebSocket endpoints.

methods.name: defaultArgs
methods.description: Generates default command-line arguments for launching Chromium.

methods.name: _innerDefaultArgs
methods.description: Constructs the core set of command-line arguments based on options.

methods.name: waitForReadyState
methods.description: Waits for the browser to be ready, retrieving the WebSocket endpoint.

methods.name: getExecutableName
methods.description: Determines the executable name based on options and channel.
